name: com.hootlens/mcp
title: Hoot Lens
description: Read Hoot Lens recordings, replays, heatmaps, funnels and findings with your own account.

environmentVariables.name: HOOTLENS_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Hoot Lens access key (dashboard, Settings, AI assistant). Optional: without it the server uses the sign-in from 'npx -y @hootlens/mcp login'.

environmentVariables.name: HOOTLENS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Hoot Lens API origin. Leave unset to use the production API.

environmentVariables.name: HOOTLENS_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Project ID that tools use by default.

environmentVariables.name: HOOTLENS_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated toolsets to offer: read, replay, annotate, configure, sites, install, feedback, issues, default, all. Optional grants and account authority still apply.
